description: This file defines the internal class StatelessWorkerGrainContext, which manages the context and lifecycle of stateless worker grains within the Orleans runtime. It handles message processing, worker creation, deactivation, idle worker removal, and resource disposal, implementing various interfaces for activation lifecycle and disposal.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerGrainContext
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle and message processing of stateless grain workers, including worker creation, message dispatch, idle worker removal, and cleanup.

methods.name: RunMessageLoop
methods.description: Asynchronous method that runs the main message processing loop for the grain context, handling queued work items.

methods.name: CollectIdleWorkers
methods.description: Implements a control mechanism based on PID-like feedback to decide when to deactivate idle worker instances to optimize resource usage.

methods.name: ReceiveMessageInternal
methods.description: Internal method to enqueue and process incoming messages, creating new workers if necessary.

methods.name: CreateWorker
methods.description: Creates a new worker activation context, initializes it, and adds it to the worker list.

methods.name: DeactivatedTaskInternal
methods.description: Completes the deactivation process for all workers and signals completion.

methods.name: DisposeAsyncInternal
methods.description: Disposes all resources asynchronously, including timers and worker activations.

methods.name: OnCreateActivation
methods.description: Lifecycle callback invoked when an activation is created.

methods.name: OnDestroyActivation
methods.description: Enqueues a request to handle destruction of an activation.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Handles context rehydration, currently does not support migration, but disposes the provided rehydration context if any.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Placeholder method for migration logic, currently not supported.
